title: The floor plan document: rooms and sensor positions in metres (SPEC-028)

floor_id.description: HA floor id, null in a home without floors

open_spaces.description: Groups of rooms open to each other without doors (SPEC-028 Amendment 7): their heat maps share readings. Each area in one group at most; every area a room of the floor

openings.description: Doors, windows and doorways in the rooms' walls (SPEC-028 Amendment 9): an opening joins two rooms of the floor, or one and the outside (null)

kind.description: Default door; an opening is a doorway without a leaf, always open; fixed is glass that never opens (a fixed window, a glass wall)

at.description: Its centre in metres, on the rooms' shared wall (or the room's outer wall)

width.description: Metres; default 0.8 for a door or a doorway, 1.0 for a window or fixed glass

state.description: When no entity is linked or it is unavailable; default open between rooms, closed to the outside

entity.description: The opening's live state: a door, window or opening binary_sensor, or a cover

sliding.description: A door: slides along the wall instead of swinging

hinge.description: A door: its hinge (a sliding door: where it slides to), seen from the side it opens into, facing it; default left

opens.description: A door: the room it opens into, one of its rooms, or outside; default its first room

placed.description: false: at its area's room centre, not yet dragged

category.description: Overrides the category categories/*.yaml give the point (SPEC-028 Amendment 5); the placeable ids

also.description: Other Home Assistant devices that are the same hardware as this point's device (an amplifier seen by its own, a Cast and a DLNA integration); only on a device point (SPEC-028 Amendment 5, stage 2)

source.description: Only in the home repository's file: the traced image and its scale
